ns2:course.label: Venture Funded Startups
ns2:course.description: Introduces the concepts, tools, and language used by Venture Capitalists (VCs). Specifically, covers venture-scale opportunity assessment and articulation; venture capital financing and valuation; deal structure; term sheets; financial plans for startups; customer development and marketing; product iterations; and sales execution. Same as TE 567. Prerequisite: ENG 566.
